slides.texte_overlay:
01 Cut the noise

Mute the feeds that make you
feel behind. Your attention
is the first thing to win back.

02 Win the first hour

Same wake-up time. Water, light,
no phone. The day follows
the way it starts.

03 Move every day

A walk, a run, a gym session.
Motion first, motivation later.

04 Rebuild your circle

Spend more time with people
who ask what you're building.

05 Learn again

Pick up what school never
taught you. A little every day
compounds into a new man.
